```artifact
Feature: Manage Doctors and Chemists in the Administrator's Menu

  As an administrator, I want to manage doctors and chemists so that I can maintain the healthcare system effectively.

  Scenario: Adding a new doctor
  Given I am on the Administrator's Menu
  When I navigate to the Add Doctor screen
  And I enter valid doctor details
  Then a new doctor should be added to the system

  Scenario: Adding a doctor with existing doctor ID
  Given I am on the Administrator's Menu
  When I navigate to the Add Doctor screen
  And I enter doctor details with an existing doctor ID
  Then an exception error should be displayed "Doctor does not exist"

  Scenario: Editing a doctor's details
  Given I am on the Administrator's Menu
  When I navigate to the Edit/Update Doctor screen
  And I enter valid doctor details
  Then the doctor's details should be updated in the system

  Scenario: Editing a doctor with non-existing doctor ID
  Given I am on the Administrator's Menu
  When I navigate to the Edit/Update Doctor screen
  And I enter doctor details with a non-existing doctor ID
  Then an exception error should be displayed "Doctor does not exist"

  Scenario: Deleting a doctor's details
  Given I am on the Administrator's Menu
  When I navigate to the Edit/Update Doctor screen
  And I enter doctor details with an existing doctor ID
  Then I should be able to delete the doctor's details if there are no open consultation requests
  Otherwise, an exception error should be displayed "Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete"

  Scenario: Adding a new chemist
  Given I am on the Administrator's Menu
  When I navigate to the Add Chemist/Lab screen
  And I enter valid chemist/lab details
  Then a new chemist/lab should be added to the system

  Scenario: Adding a chemist with existing chemist ID
  Given I am on the Administrator's Menu
  When I navigate to the Add Chemist/Lab screen
  And I enter chemist/lab details with an existing chemist ID
  Then an exception error should be displayed "Chemist does not exist"

  Scenario: Editing a chemist's details
  Given I am on the Administrator's Menu
  When I navigate to the Add Chemist/Lab screen
  And I enter valid chemist/lab details
  Then the chemist/lab details should be updated in the system

  Scenario: Editing a chemist with non-existing chemist ID
  Given I am on the Administrator's Menu
  When I navigate to the Add Chemist/Lab screen
  And I enter chemist/lab details with a non-existing chemist ID
  Then an exception error should be displayed "Chemist does not exist"

  Scenario: Deleting a chemist's details
  Given I am on the Administrator's Menu
  When I navigate to the Add Chemist/Lab screen
  And I enter chemist/lab details with an existing chemist ID
  Then I should be able to delete the chemist/lab details if there are no open consultation requests
  Otherwise, an exception error should be displayed "Chemist has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete"
```
